CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_bed_occupancy_timeline(p_bed_id uuid, p_from date, p_to date)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  v_now date := current_date;
  v_to  date := least(p_to, current_date);
  v_from date;
  result jsonb;
begin
  if p_bed_id is null then return '[]'::jsonb; end if;

  -- Bed availability window start, clamped to p_from.
  select greatest(coalesce(a.start_date, p_from), p_from)
    into v_from
  from beds b join apartments a on a.id = b.apartment_id
  where b.id = p_bed_id;
  v_from := coalesce(v_from, p_from);

  with
  occ as (  -- occupied segments (Staying/On-Notice/Exited), clamped to window
    select greatest(ta.onboarding_date, v_from) as seg_from,
           least(coalesce(ta.actual_exit_date, v_now), v_to) as seg_to,
           ta.tenant_id
    from tenant_allotments ta
    where ta.bed_id = p_bed_id
      and ta.staying_status in ('Staying','On-Notice','Exited')
      and ta.onboarding_date is not null
  ),
  occ_clean as (
    select seg_from, seg_to, tenant_id from occ where seg_to >= seg_from order by seg_from
  ),
  occ_seg as (
    select 'occupied' as state, seg_from as seg_from, seg_to as seg_to,
           (seg_to - seg_from) + 1 as days, tenant_id
    from occ_clean
  ),
  -- vacant gaps = window minus occupied, computed between consecutive occupied segments
  bounds as (
    select seg_from, seg_to,
           lag(seg_to) over (order by seg_from) as prev_to
    from occ_clean
  ),
  gap_mid as (
    select 'vacant' as state, (prev_to + 1) as seg_from, (seg_from - 1) as seg_to,
           (seg_from - 1) - (prev_to + 1) + 1 as days, null::uuid as tenant_id
    from bounds where prev_to is not null and (seg_from - 1) >= (prev_to + 1)
  ),
  gap_lead as (  -- vacancy before first occupancy
    select 'vacant' as state, v_from as seg_from, (min(seg_from) - 1) as seg_to,
           (min(seg_from) - 1) - v_from + 1 as days, null::uuid as tenant_id
    from occ_clean having min(seg_from) > v_from
  ),
  gap_trail as ( -- vacancy after last occupancy up to window end
    select 'vacant' as state, (max(seg_to) + 1) as seg_from, v_to as seg_to,
           v_to - (max(seg_to) + 1) + 1 as days, null::uuid as tenant_id
    from occ_clean having max(seg_to) < v_to
  ),
  all_no_occ as ( -- fully vacant window (no occupancy at all)
    select 'vacant' as state, v_from as seg_from, v_to as seg_to,
           (v_to - v_from) + 1 as days, null::uuid as tenant_id
    where not exists (select 1 from occ_clean) and v_to >= v_from
  ),
  unioned as (
    select * from occ_seg
    union all select * from gap_mid
    union all select * from gap_lead
    union all select * from gap_trail
    union all select * from all_no_occ
  )
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
           'state', state, 'from', seg_from, 'to', seg_to, 'days', days, 'tenant_id', tenant_id
         ) order by seg_from), '[]'::jsonb)
  into result
  from unioned where days > 0;

  return result;
end;
$function$
